alt: Person holding the Dyson CameraJet electric toothbrush with its built-in camera visible near the brush head
story: Dyson's September 2026 CameraJet is a $499 electric toothbrush with a built-in Wi-Fi camera that streams live footage of your molars to your phone; it took six years and 661 engineers to build.
why_funny: Dyson rebranded a dental endoscope as a toothbrush, filed 38 patents, and expected the public to pay $499 to watch their own teeth in real time.
